text: Separate pipeline replay from true self-hosting; require a compiler-produced-by-stage-N artifact to compile the compiler source.
Use differential checks against an independent reference before requiring stage-to-stage fixed-point identity.
Require explicit loop and scanner progress invariants so source-level control flow cannot silently stop making progress.
Preserve the distinction between value-producing expressions and statement blocks during lowering and stack/register management.
Prefer structured tokens, AST nodes, types, effects, ownership, and source mappings over serialized intermediate representations.
Make lexer, parser, semantic, lowering, code-generation, and runtime failures first-class and source-addressable.
Test malformed and adversarial compiler inputs as first-class regression cases, not only successful programs.
Make every bootstrap stage content-addressed and reproducible across repeated executions.
Retain failure, diagnosis, repair, verification, regression replay, and later outcome as one learning chain.
Transfer generalized lessons as advisory priors without importing source-project code, paths, dependencies, or authority.
